invariants.rationale: Methods returning Option<T> from the codebase generally never return null but Option.empty().
A rollback cannot be scheduled without a valid instant to rollback; method implementation delegates but expect parameter to be non-null.
instantTime is used to identify rollback instants, and should not be null throughout.
context is required for execution and delegated to the executor, so must hold.
Option can be present or not, this invariant is always true and ensures Option contract is respected (tautological, but included for completeness).
